mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart_item (cart_item_id, cart_id, product_id, sku_id, quantity) VALUES (#{cartItemId}, #{cartId}, #{productId}, #{skuId}, #{quantity})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cart_item WHERE cart_id = #{cartId} AND sku_id = #{skuId}
mapper.select: SELECT ci.cart_item_id, ci.product_id, p.product_name, ci.sku_id, ci.quantity, ( SELECT pi.image_path FROM product_image pi WHERE pi.product_id = p.product_id AND pi.image_type = 'THUMB' ORDER BY pi.sort_order ASC, pi.image_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS thumbPath, GROUP_CONCAT( CONCAT(po.option_name, ': ', pov.option_value) ORDER BY pov.sort_order SEPARATOR ' / ' ) AS option_summary FROM cart_item ci JOIN products p ON ci.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN option_value_sku ovs ON ci.sku_id = ovs.sku_id LEFT JOIN product_option_value pov ON ovs.option_value_id = pov.option_value_id LEFT JOIN product_option po ON pov.option_id = po.option_id WHERE ci.cart_id = #{cartId} GROUP BY ci.cart_item_id, ci.product_id, p.product_name, ci.sku_id, ci.quantity
